messages.subject: Analyst Position
parts:
Hello All,
Myself and some collaborators have procured a NFWF grant for some salt marsh harvest mouse research here in the bay, and we have some money to hire an analyst, and I thought some folks on this list might be interested and qualified.  At a baseline we are going to be building some population models and testing environmental correlates, but if we had the right person, it could potentially go a lot further.  The position would essentially be a post-doc type position.  I think the grant controller was trying to run it as an actual post-doc position through UCD, but I think there is also a pretty good chance that they would hire the person outright.  If you are interested, or know someone who might be interested and qualified please let me know.  We aren't super concerned about degrees, we just basically need someone who is better at analysis than I am.  Bonus points for familiarity with the habitats and wildlife of the San Francisco Bay. 

Thanks!
🐀
Katie
